snapshot.sql: SELECT now() AS snapshot_at, current_date AS server_date, current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only, current_setting('transaction_isolation') AS isolation

confidence_pooled_5d.sql: SELECT floor(confidence/10)*10 AS band, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_correct_5d) AS wins, min(confidence) AS lo, max(confidence) AS hi FROM signal_outcomes WHERE confidence IS NOT NULL AND return_5d IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

confidence_180d.sql: SELECT o.horizon, o.signal_direction, s.market, CASE WHEN confidence>=0 AND confidence<40 THEN '0-40' WHEN confidence<55 AND confidence>=40 THEN '40-55' WHEN confidence<70 AND confidence>=55 THEN '55-70' WHEN confidence<85 AND confidence>=70 THEN '70-85' WHEN confidence<101 AND confidence>=85 THEN '85+' ELSE 'outside' END AS band, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_correct) AS wins, count(DISTINCT o.symbol) AS symbols, count(DISTINCT signal_date) AS dates, avg(pct_return) AS raw_return FROM signal_outcomes o JOIN stocks s ON s.id=o.stock_id WHERE is_correct IS NOT NULL AND o.signal_date >= current_date-180 GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

confidence_since_sep01.sql: SELECT o.horizon, o.signal_direction, s.market, CASE WHEN confidence>=0 AND confidence<40 THEN '0-40' WHEN confidence<55 AND confidence>=40 THEN '40-55' WHEN confidence<70 AND confidence>=55 THEN '55-70' WHEN confidence<85 AND confidence>=70 THEN '70-85' WHEN confidence<101 AND confidence>=85 THEN '85+' ELSE 'outside' END AS band, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_correct) AS wins, count(DISTINCT o.symbol) AS symbols, count(DISTINCT signal_date) AS dates, avg(pct_return) AS raw_return FROM signal_outcomes o JOIN stocks s ON s.id=o.stock_id WHERE is_correct IS NOT NULL AND o.signal_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

confidence_pooled_market.sql: SELECT horizon, signal_direction, CASE WHEN confidence>=0 AND confidence<40 THEN '0-40' WHEN confidence<55 AND confidence>=40 THEN '40-55' WHEN confidence<70 AND confidence>=55 THEN '55-70' WHEN confidence<85 AND confidence>=70 THEN '70-85' WHEN confidence<101 AND confidence>=85 THEN '85+' ELSE 'outside' END AS band, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_correct) AS wins FROM signal_outcomes WHERE is_correct IS NOT NULL AND signal_date>=current_date-180 GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

flow_5d_direction.sql: SELECT direction, count(*) AS n, count(return_5d) AS resolved, count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_correct_5d) AS wins, count(*) FILTER(WHERE return_5d>0.005) AS up, count(*) FILTER(WHERE return_5d < -0.005) AS down, count(*) FILTER(WHERE return_5d BETWEEN -0.005 AND 0.005) AS neutral, avg(return_5d) AS mean_return, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY return_5d) AS median_return, count(DISTINCT symbol) FILTER(WHERE return_5d IS NOT NULL) AS symbols, count(DISTINCT fired_date) FILTER(WHERE return_5d IS NOT NULL) AS dates, count(DISTINCT (symbol,fired_date)) FILTER(WHERE return_5d IS NOT NULL) AS symbol_dates, min(fired_date) AS first_date, max(fired_date) AS last_date FROM options_flow_alert_outcomes GROUP BY direction ORDER BY direction

flow_5d_side.sql: SELECT direction, option_type, ask_side_dominant, count(*) AS n, count(return_5d) AS resolved, count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_correct_5d) AS wins, count(*) FILTER(WHERE return_5d>0.005) AS up, count(*) FILTER(WHERE return_5d < -0.005) AS down, count(*) FILTER(WHERE return_5d BETWEEN -0.005 AND 0.005) AS neutral, avg(return_5d) AS mean_return, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY return_5d) AS median_return, count(DISTINCT symbol) FILTER(WHERE return_5d IS NOT NULL) AS symbols, count(DISTINCT fired_date) FILTER(WHERE return_5d IS NOT NULL) AS dates, count(DISTINCT (symbol,fired_date)) FILTER(WHERE return_5d IS NOT NULL) AS symbol_dates, min(fired_date) AS first_date, max(fired_date) AS last_date FROM options_flow_alert_outcomes GROUP BY direction, option_type, ask_side_dominant ORDER BY direction, option_type, ask_side_dominant

flow_5d_clusters.sql: SELECT direction,symbol,fired_date, count(*) AS contracts, avg(return_5d) AS ret, min(entry_date) AS entry_date, avg(CASE WHEN is_correct_5d THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS win_fraction FROM options_flow_alert_outcomes WHERE return_5d IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

flow_10d_direction.sql: SELECT direction, count(*) AS n, count(return_10d) AS resolved, count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_correct_10d) AS wins, count(*) FILTER(WHERE return_10d>0.005) AS up, count(*) FILTER(WHERE return_10d < -0.005) AS down, count(*) FILTER(WHERE return_10d BETWEEN -0.005 AND 0.005) AS neutral, avg(return_10d) AS mean_return, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY return_10d) AS median_return, count(DISTINCT symbol) FILTER(WHERE return_10d IS NOT NULL) AS symbols, count(DISTINCT fired_date) FILTER(WHERE return_10d IS NOT NULL) AS dates, count(DISTINCT (symbol,fired_date)) FILTER(WHERE return_10d IS NOT NULL) AS symbol_dates, min(fired_date) AS first_date, max(fired_date) AS last_date FROM options_flow_alert_outcomes GROUP BY direction ORDER BY direction

flow_10d_clusters.sql: SELECT direction,symbol,fired_date, count(*) AS contracts, avg(return_10d) AS ret, min(entry_date) AS entry_date, avg(CASE WHEN is_correct_10d THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS win_fraction FROM options_flow_alert_outcomes WHERE return_10d IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

dark_summary.sql: SELECT count(*) AS prints, count(DISTINCT symbol) AS symbols, min(executed_at) AS earliest, max(executed_at) AS latest FROM dark_pool_prints

dark_daily.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT (executed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day, count(*) AS prints, count(DISTINCT symbol) AS observed_symbols FROM dark_pool_prints WHERE executed_at>=current_date-21 GROUP BY 1), a AS (SELECT fired_date AS day, count(*) AS alerts, count(DISTINCT symbol) AS alert_symbols FROM dark_pool_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date>=current_date-21 GROUP BY 1) SELECT coalesce(p.day,a.day) AS day, prints,observed_symbols,alerts,alert_symbols FROM p FULL JOIN a USING(day) ORDER BY day

gex_by_type.sql: SELECT alert_type,gex_corroborated,count(*) AS n,count(return_5d) AS resolved,count(DISTINCT symbol) FILTER(WHERE return_5d IS NOT NULL) AS symbols,count(DISTINCT fired_date) FILTER(WHERE return_5d IS NOT NULL) AS dates,avg(return_5d) AS avg_return FROM squeeze_alert_outcomes GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

prebreakout.sql: SELECT symbol,count(*) AS n,count(return_5d) AS resolved_5d,count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_correct_5d) AS wins_5d,avg(return_5d) AS ret_5d,count(return_20d) AS resolved_20d,avg(return_20d) AS ret_20d FROM prebreakout_alert_outcomes GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
